title: Near copy of bank divisors
statement: How many positive divisors does $720$ have?
hints: Name the units digit, since the tens digit depends on it.
Use the place value of each digit to list the options: the tens digit is at most $9$, which limits the units digit.
solution: Since $720 = 2^4\cdot 3^2\cdot 5$, there are $5\cdot 3\cdot 2 = 30$ divisors. Why this works. place-value-representation: the tens digit is at most nine, which limits the units digit.
check_program: print(sum(1 for d in range(1, 721) if 720 % d == 0))
